correctness.rationale: Proved the private-coordinate lemma, the multigraph reduction (including parallels) and three-vertex cover from the full hit trace. All seven-edge multigraphs with such a cover are encoded by three core multiplicities and a multiset of 3-coordinate peripheral vectors. The standalone exhaustive verifier enumerates 9,177 profiles (independently re-counted by a coefficient formula), finds at most 124 of the 128 hit traces, and checks explicit witnesses for ranks 1–6. A separate size proof gives the sharp ground-size onsets. Verified script execution completed successfully.

value.rationale: The edge relation on a natural fixed-rank class of distance-regular Kneser graphs has a complete exact finite-VC profile with a nontrivial sharp onset at 13. This complements known Johnson/Hamming structural-tameness results while distinguishing disjointness adjacency (maximum six) from Johnson adjacency (maximum four); it replaces only-instance computation by a universal exhaustive obstruction and explicit witnesses, directly relevant to VC-based learning/sample bounds and finite model-theoretic dependence.
